text: In accordance with Board of Governors of Exhibition Place Procedure By-law, The Board determines the place, day and hour of its regular Meetings and the schedule of those Meetings shall be publicly available by the first Meeting of the Board in each calendar year. City Council on July 24 and 25, 2024 approved the 2025 schedule of meetings for City Council and its Committees. The schedule of meetings for the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place has been developed to avoid dates, whenever possible, that conflict with the approved City Council schedule; and to avoid days of cultural or religious significance. The following meetings of the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place have been scheduled for 2025: Date: Tuesday February 4, 2025 Time: 9:30 a.m. Location: Beanfield Centre, 105 Princes’ Boulevard Room 204/Video Conference Date: Monday April 28, 2025 Time: 9:30 a.m. Location:…
